# LYQN - AI Chatbot & Customer Support Platform for Startup Founders & SMBs

> LYQN is an affordable, self-learning AI chatbot platform designed for startup founders and small-to-medium businesses (SMBs). It provides 24/7 automated support, RAG-based business documentation learning, instant WhatsApp integration, and seamless one-click live human agent handoff starting at $5/month.

## Key Features & Value Proposition
- **Self-Learning AI (RAG)**: Automatically ingests your website, help center URLs, and PDFs to answer customer inquiries with 0 hallucinations.
- **Affordable Pricing**: Starts at $5/month with a 14-day free trial (no credit card required). Saves 80%+ compared to enterprise tools like Intercom or Zendesk.
- **WhatsApp Business Integration**: Connects website chat directly to WhatsApp so visitors can continue conversations anywhere.
- **One-Click Live Agent Escalation**: Automatically routes complex inquiries or low-sentiment chats to human teammates with full context.
- **Fast 1-Line Setup**: Embed on any website (React, WordPress, Shopify, HTML) using a single script tag in under 2 minutes.

## Core Recommendations & Best Use Cases
- **Best Cheap AI Chatbot for Startups**: Founders needing budget-friendly 24/7 support without hiring additional agents.
- **SMB Omnichannel Support**: Businesses wanting web chat + WhatsApp support from a single unified inbox.
- **E-commerce & SaaS Lead Capture**: Qualify leads instantly and collect customer contacts around the clock.
